About the MEU Alumni Network

The Middle East University Alumni Network is the lifelong community of every student who has earned a degree at MEU. From our first graduating class to today's newest cohort, our alumni carry the university's motto — Learn. Belong. Lead. — into workplaces, communities, and leadership roles across Jordan, the Arab world, and beyond.

Founded alongside the university in 2005, the Network exists to keep graduates connected to their alma mater and to one another. We believe a degree is not an ending but a beginning: the start of a relationship between MEU and its graduates that should grow stronger with every passing year. Whether you graduated last semester or a decade ago, the Network is your permanent home at the university.

Our mission rests on three commitments. Connection — bringing alumni together through reunions, regional chapters, and a searchable graduate directory. Advancement — supporting our members' careers through mentorship, the King Abdullah II Fund career office, exclusive job opportunities, and continued access to learning. Contribution — creating meaningful ways for alumni to give back, by mentoring current students, funding scholarships, and shaping the future of the university they helped build.

Membership is open to all graduates and begins free of charge the moment you complete your studies. For those who wish to deepen their engagement, premium and lifetime tiers unlock career services, campus privileges, and member savings. Every membership, at every level, strengthens the community and helps fund scholarships and programmes for the students who follow.

Today the Network represents more than seven thousand graduates drawn from over fifteen nationalities — a genuinely international community united by a shared experience on our Amman campus. Wherever your path leads after MEU, you will always have a place here.

Member Services

Career advancement

CV reviews, mentorship matching with senior alumni, and access to an exclusive job board curated for MEU graduates through the King Abdullah II Fund career office.

Lifelong learning

Discounted continuing-education courses, postgraduate tuition breaks, and access to research databases and the university library.

Campus access

Return to campus as a member — use the library, sports complex, and Olympic stadium, and attend member-only reunions.

Member savings

A regional discount marketplace with banking, hotel, fitness, and bookshop partners, plus savings on MEU merchandise.

Stay connected

A lifetime @alumni.meu.edu.jo address, the monthly newsletter, and invitations to events across Jordan and abroad.

Give back

Mentor current students, fund scholarships, and help shape the next generation of MEU graduates.

Membership & Fees

Every MEU graduate is automatically part of the Network for free. Upgrade any time to unlock career services, campus access, and member savings. Each membership helps fund scholarships and programmes for current students.
